source_interpretation: Composed legend controls solid=spring and dashed=shell; raw strip wording 'shear' is not a third series. Source-native color and continuous/broken style guide local attribution, never expected load ordering. Published white overlays, legend ink, axes and ticks are excluded from curve evidence. Saved per-strip CTMs, including Im5's different pitch, govern any future coordinate conversion.
seam_format: Each row is [upper strip, lower strip, solid disposition, dashed disposition]. 'Not reached' means no attributed curve fragment in the inspected boundary neighborhood, not proof of latent absence or zero. Compatible local pieces never constitute an accepted join.
common_requirements: Separated local pieces are candidates for native-footprint and graphical uncertainty work. Crowded origins, same-color contacts, hidden segments and axis/border contacts retain alternative identities. Do not bridge ordinary-looking dash gaps or extrapolate. No quantified difference, force/energy consistency, failure coordinate or full-route continuity follows. Original arrays are one possible remedy for specific unresolved portions, not an exclusive prerequisite for every bounded graphical claim.
